title: blaze skeleton
description:
Added Blaze Skeleton with unique abilities:

Immune to fire and lava.

Can spawn in any dimension (Overworld, Nether, End).

Custom AI for aggressive fire-based combat.
body:
Blaze Skeleton Mod adds a new challenging mob to your Minecraft world. This mob is a hybrid of a Blaze and a Skeleton, acting as a hostile enemy. It can spawn naturally in both the Nether and The End dimensions. It combines the ranged fire attacks of a Blaze with the agility of a Skeleton, making survival much harder.

Features:

Custom hybrid mob design.

Spawns in Nether and End.

Challenging combat mechanics.

Created by: wardenbabapiro31
